mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tag ( tag_group_id, name, sort_order, init_regi_pic, init_regi_dttm, final_rvis_pic, final_rvis_dttm ) VALUES ( #{tagGroupId}, #{name}, #{sortOrder}, #{initRegiPic}, #{initRegiDttm}, #{finalRvisPic}, #{finalRvisDttm} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, tag_group_id, name, sort_order, init_regi_pic, init_regi_dttm, final_rvis_pic, final_rvis_dttm FROM tag WHERE id = #{id}
